verdict.rationale: Milvus documents four multi-tenancy strategies, each trading off scalability, data isolation, and flexibility, which covers the namespace, partition, and per-collection options in the story. RBAC scoped to collection, database, and instance levels backs up tenant isolation. Missing for 10: the specific strategies (database/collection/partition/partition-key) are not detailed in the evidence, no documented per-tenant or collection/partition count limits, no evidence on cost efficiency at high tenant counts, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
